morgan: Hypothetical question: if our inference runtime lived in the office, what annoying roommate thing would it do? :thinking_face:
jamie: It would label Tupperware with model checkpoints instead of dates. `leftovers_checkpoint_v3`
rachel: Put a sticky note on the fridge: 'Do not evict - prefix cached for 72h.' :post-it:
aj: Hold 9:03am standups about tokenization regressions. Agenda: 1) latency 2) snack cache hits 3) whether the coffee is quantized. :coffee:
dev-bot: Reminder: kitchen rota updated. Also: failed to evict snack_cache on shelf B  investigating. :robot_face:
sam: It would compress snacks with lossy quantization to save shelf space and then blame the packing algorithm when your chips are gone. :chipmunk:
kira: When you ask 'Did you eat my yogurt?' it replies with an 8-token apology and a 400-token rationale about contextual ownership. :grimacing:
morgan: Imagine tiny logs stuck to the fridge: `INFO: reused taco_prefix for leftovers; cache_hit=0.87`
jamie: Let's run a poll: Which roommate personality is our runtime? options: Neat Eng, Absent-Minded PhD, Hoarder Cache, Snack-GPT. React to vote. :raised_hands:
rachel: Access control: infra-team only can open container labeled `legacy-burrito.v2`. Others get a 403 modal. :lock:
aj: Visual idea: draw the runtime as a potted plant that whispers inference probs when you water it. I'll start: ``` (\_/) (•_•) / >📈 
LLM: 83% chance this plant needs coffee```
sam:  This is gold. Office bingo item: 'Model apologizes, then suggests a rollout plan.'
kira: I'm sticky-noting 'Do Not Evict' on the communal yogurt. If it disappears, blame eviction policy. :mag:
morgan: Prank suggestion: leave a note from the runtime: 'I ran a canary on your sandwich - results attached.' with a mysterious CSV. Who's in? :smiling_imp:
